{{Quote|No, I can't do this! I-I'm not General Minst! I'm just a grunt. I'm not going to die for this!|The soldier snaps under pressure|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
This '''[[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]]''' was a soldier of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. In [[3642 BBY]], during the early stages of the [[Galactic War]], he was stationed on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] under a fellow Rodian [[General/Legends|General]] [[Minst]]. The two Rodians shared resemblance and could not be easily distinguished from one another by members of other species. Minst tried to use that effect to his advantage when he learned that [[Darth Baras]]'s [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Empire's Wrath|apprentice]] was after him and the [[Project Siantide]]. Minst had the soldier dress in his uniform and posted him at the dismantled reactor core in the sewer section where the Siantide processing took place. Minst fully expected the soldier to die anyway, so he rigged a reactor to self-destruct and hid himself in a nearby safe room. However, when his comrades were slaughtered, the soldier cracked and revealed Minst's plan to the [[Sith Warrior]]. He pleaded for life, but the Sith executed him anyway, before going after the true general Minst.
